description: 1 staging, 2 main, 3 upper. A switch number is on one level only; the numbers are unique railroad-wide.
The switch number (the plate number). A switch's rows go together, its first row first: a crossover has one row per OS block (staging: 7 and 7b) or per half (main and upper: 101A and 101B).

Main and upper: the label the drawings print for this row, the switch number (107) or the number and A or B for a crossover half (101A). It is the row's key. Staging leaves it blank: its rows are keyed by os_block.

The OS block through this row's points (OS Switch 7, OS Switch 7b). Staging gives it on every row, once per block; the first row's is the switch's primary OS block (the Layout Editor blockname and first CTC OS sensor). Main and upper may give it; none does yet.
The block the leg leads to when the switch is closed (CATS normal unless cats_inverted). Given with thrown_leg and os_block, or not at all; staging gives both on every row.
The block the leg leads to when the switch is thrown.
L or R: the diverging side seen from the points, or blank where nobody has recorded it. Main and upper give it per half; staging on the switch's first row.

Where the hand comes from: plan (main and upper only; tools/schematic/build_hands.py writes it from the AnyRail plan graph and rewrites only these rows) or owner (hand-kept; build_hands.py never touches it). Blank when hand is blank.

Main and upper: the LCOS node area of a local switch, one in no control point (a yard or industry spur). Blank for a control point switch, whose area is its interlocking's (interlockings.csv). On the switch's first row only.
Staging: the live Layout Editor turnout ident (TOL3). On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Staging: yes when CATS normal is JMRI thrown, else no. On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Staging: the USS CTC lever's first internal sensor number (IS<n>), given to one switch only. On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Staging: yes when the USS CTC lever column has signal levers, no for a switch-only column. On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Free text for people. On the switch's first row only.
